title: Count the Steps
brief:
A while loop repeats until something changes. When you already know how many times to repeat, a for loop says so directly:

for step in range(10):
    right()

range(10) produces the numbers 0 to 9 — ten of them — so the body runs ten times. The variable step holds the current number each time around; you do not have to use it.

The flag is ten tiles to your right. Count them on the screen and check.
